main_body: three 16x16 sand ground tiles (plain sand, rippled sand, sand with starfish and shell)
evidence: Ground terrain tiles (sand patches); top-down surface filling all 16 rows is appropriate for terrain kind.

style.evidence: The main sand material uses only 3 main tan values (base tan, one lighter highlight, one darker shadow) plus tiny isolated accent details on the rightmost tile. Large areas (e.g. cols 0-5 rows 5-15, cols 32-38 rows 5-15) are solid flat tan with only sparse single-pixel specks, visibly flatter and sparser than the Beodeul grass/paving references.
